chapter: Publishing, Jelly Roll in Los Angeles and band lore
title: Colonel Carnahan of the 25th Infantry and the Queen's Palace draft office
summary: The colonel assembled the best athletes and wanted a jazz band; Spikes was drafted in the Queen's Throne Room of the Hawaiian palace in Honolulu.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: You mentioned the Colonel of the Twenty-Fifth Infantry and how he asked for your band and he also had all the best athletes and everything. You remember his name?
'Cause he sounded like kind of an interesting person.

Yeh heh heh. Well, he...he was very...he was one of the...he had...he had all the great football...football players and baseball players and runners and jumpers and everything. He had a...I don't know how he accumulated all of 'em in the Twenty-Fifth but he did have, and when they used to play against the Tenth Cavalry down there, and they'd beat 'em all the time, and they wanted to...they knew we was drafted, and they got permission for us to join the Twenty-Fifth Infantry.
You mentioned being...you said you were drafted in the Queen's Throne Room of the Queen's Palace...
Yeah, in Honolulu. That's...that was where the draft headquarters was.
I don't...the Queen's Throne Room of the Queen's Palace--what, was that a...a queen...?
Well, you know, Hawaii used to have a queen.
That's what I...I didn't know...was that place was the Queen's...
Yeah! A queen and a king!
And that was the actual palace of the...

Yeah, you know, it was a historical thing then, you know, then. Yeah. I guess it's still there because it was the Queen's Palace, you know. I guess it's still there. Yeah, but that's where their draftin' headquarters was.
I wanted to ask you about that because I wasn't certain whether it was the historical place or whether maybe there was a hotel or an entertainment place that had that name.
